public_rationale: Large financial forecast revisions are documented. That supports scrutiny of the companies' projections, but does not establish increasing concealment by both companies. The inspected report labels the figures as forecasts and does not identify who supplied them. Later accounts can test reported results, but cannot alone show that earlier projections were knowingly misleading. The required record of provenance, contemporaneous knowledge and an increasing two-year pattern is missing.
limitations: Several original financial reports were inaccessible through read_page.
This finding does not establish that the companies' disclosures were complete or candid.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: For the past two years, OpenAI and Anthropic have increasingly hidden the truth about their finances through repeated leaks to the media.

statement.excerpt: What I’m trying to get at is that OpenAI (and, for that matter, Anthropic) has spent the last two years increasingly obfuscating the truth through leak after leak to the media.
statement.document_title: The AI Bubble Is An Information War

from_speaker: through leak after leak to the media
our_interpretation: The described period is the two years preceding the March 3, 2026 post.
The plain reading is that both companies repeatedly supplied materially misleading financial information through leaks, with the practice becoming more pronounced over time.
Obfuscation requires more than changed forecasts: evidence must establish misleading presentation or material omission relative to what was known when information was supplied.
This is a claim about disclosure conduct, not a particular monetary amount, so contract metric_scope is null.
criteria.support_condition: A dated record for both companies establishes repeated company-originated financial leaks that materially concealed known facts, with increasing frequency or severity over the two-year period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive comparable record shows that the alleged misleading leaks were accurate and adequately qualified when issued, or that the asserted increasing pattern did not occur.
